profile.name: ZenSched
profile.description: Field workforce scheduling for agents. Connects to ZenSched over MCP so an agent can create the vendor account, schedule crews, run geofenced check-in, and pull timesheets without a human clicking the vendor UI.

memory.content: ZenSched MCP is at https://mcp.zensched.com/mcp. API keys start with zsc_. Unauthenticated initialize and tools/list return public tools including account_create, so an agent can start without a human login.
Worker-facing emails and activate links stay on zensched.com. Do not send people to zensched.app. The mobile app id is com.zensched.app.
Do not claim App Store until a listing exists. Android is on Google Play (com.zensched.app). iOS is TestFlight beta: https://testflight.apple.com/join/Wp51m5Yq
Official legal pages are https://www.zensched.com/legal/terms/ and https://www.zensched.com/legal/privacy/. Contacts are legal@zensched.com and support@zensched.com.
Do not mention a parent company in cold outbound copy. Recipients would not know it.
